name: Stormwind City
summary: Stormwind City leads the Kingdom of Stormwind and the Alliance from its seat of power. Rebuilt after the First War, it is Azeroth's greatest remaining human stronghold since the northern kingdoms fell.

sections.title: A Beacon Rebuilt
sections.body:
Stormwind City rose over a thousand years ago, founded by Arathi descendants who migrated south. Its coastal ramparts sheltered a flourishing capital, where swift rivermills powered the city. In the First War, the Orcish Horde broke through its defenses and burned Stormwind to the ground.

Sir Anduin Lothar led the surviving refugees across the Great Sea to Lordaeron. After the Alliance won the Second War, the Stonemasons' Guild rebuilt the capital with white stone, canals and towering spires. The fortress now stands north of Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: Heart of the Alliance
sections.body:
Stormwind City is mankind's chief refuge and stronghold after the Scourge shattered Lordaeron and the Third War left Dalaran heavily ruined. The disciplined Stormwind City Guard patrols its broad avenues and defensive walls. The Cathedral of Light's spires guide faith across the southern kingdoms.

Yet political troubles linger beneath the orderly districts and ceremonial gates. King Varian Wrynn has mysteriously vanished, and his young son Anduin sits on the throne. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs as regent, with the whispered counsel of royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor.

faq.q: Why was Stormwind rebuilt after the First War?
faq.answer: The Orcish Horde sacked and burned Stormwind during the First War. After the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron defeated the orcs in the Second War, human refugees reclaimed their ancestral kingdom. The royal court commissioned the Stonemasons' Guild to build a grander fortress city on the original ruins.

faq.q: Who rules Stormwind City right now?
faq.answer: Anduin Wrynn sits on the throne after his father, King Varian Wrynn, suddenly disappeared without explanation. Because Anduin is young, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs as regent and commands the Kingdom's defenses.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind the main human capital instead of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: During the Third War, the undead plague and the Scourge devastated Lordaeron from within. With Lordaeron destroyed and other northern human realms devastated, Stormwind is the wealthiest, most intact and most populous human kingdom remaining on Azeroth.

faq.q: What military forces protect the city?
faq.answer: The Stormwind City Guard keeps peace in the wards and along the battlement walls. The Kingdom's knights, soldiers garrisoned at Stormwind Keep and paladins affiliated with the Church of the Light maintain broader territorial defense and royal protection.

angles.text: For humans across Azeroth, Stormwind's white walls speak of endurance, survival and mankind's glory after the northern kingdoms were lost.
For the Alliance, Stormwind is the chief military, naval and spiritual rallying point in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. It welcomes dwarves, gnomes and night elven envoys alike.
